title: Resident Evil: The Mercenaries 3D (3DS, EUR CTR-P-ABMP, .code sha256 85a34c86...821be)
notes: The catalog names the 7z '(USA)', but the image inside is the EUR build (product CTR-P-ABMP, title 0004000000038B00); its .code is the one gbox.merc3d_exe pins.

Guest virtual addresses (ARM11, code at 0x100000, .data 0x8AA000, .bss to 0x92F000, heap 0x08000000, linear heap 0x14000000), read through Citra's page table in the RetroArch process (gbox.citra_memory): the citra core has no libretro memory map.

MT Framework Mobile: every manager is a singleton whose mpInstance sits in .bss; a class is named by its vtable (slot 5 is getDTI, the DTI's name at +4). docs/research/merc3d-ram.md has the measurements.
